name: Phone Directory
description: A console phone directory built around an ArrayList of member records.

name: Fast Food Restaurant Order Calculator
description: A Swing order calculator with sandwich choices, optional sides and drinks, an order summary, and change calculation.

name: Student Information Browser
description: A Swing browser for a small collection of student records, with separate model, window, and application-entry classes.

name: Car Inventory Lookup
description: A Swing vehicle lookup exercise using a HashMap of sample car records.

name: Personal Information Form
description: A Swing form exercise that checks input and displays a local summary.

name: Clothing Catalog Browser
description: A Swing catalog browser for four clothing records stored in a two-dimensional array.

name: Mama Mia Pizzaria
description: A dialog-based pizza order calculator.

name: Body Mass Index Calculator
description: A small dialog-based exercise in numeric input, arithmetic, and conditional categories.

name: Rectangle Area and Perimeter Calculator
description: A Swing calculator for a rectangle's area and perimeter.

name: Five-operation Calculator
description: A two-input Swing calculator for five arithmetic operations.

name: Gratuity calculator
description: A console calculator that takes a subtotal and tip percentage, then prints the gratuity and total.

name: Income-band tax exercise
description: A Java console exercise that selects a rate from five income bands and rounds the resulting tax to the nearest dollar.

name: Lottery digit matching
description: A small console game that compares a two-digit guess with a random two-digit draw.

name: Number guessing game
description: A console guessing game with a random target from 0 through 100 and high-or-low hints.

name: Coordinate geometry calculator
description: Calculates the slope and distance between two points with integer coordinates.

name: Relative grade calculator
description: Reads a group of scores and assigns letter grades relative to the highest score in the group.

name: Bank account collection exercise
description: Demonstrates object arrays, deposits and withdrawals, balance totals, filtering, and a name lookup using fictional bank accounts.

name: Six recursive methods study wrapper
description: A console demonstration of recursive counting, summation, digit counting, and digit summation.

name: Stack partition by sign
description: Reads integer stacks from a text file and places negative integers below nonnegative integers using two queues.

name: Balanced delimiter validator
description: Checks whether parentheses, brackets, braces, and angle brackets are balanced and correctly nested.

name: Sorted unique course listing
description: Reads course records from a text file and prints each distinct course name in sorted order.

name: Regional election tally exercise
description: Counts candidate tokens for several regions and reports a winner only when a candidate has a strict majority.

name: Greeting
description: A short console program that prints a greeting and a synthetic profile.

name: BMI
description: Converts pounds and inches to a BMI value and displays the exercise’s conditional result message.

name: StudentGrades
description: Averages three scores and assigns a letter grade using fixed score thresholds.

name: DiscountCalculator
description: Calculates the discount and final price for packages priced at $99 each.

name: InternetBills
description: Calculates a monthly bill for one of three fixed service plans.

name: MathTutoringGame
description: An interactive arithmetic exercise with random addition, subtraction, and multiplication questions.

name: ArraysAndWordFrequency
description: Finds distinct integers in first-seen order and counts case-insensitive words in a paragraph.

name: Account model and demonstration
description: A small account class with balance operations, interest calculations, and a console demonstration.

name: Marathon rankings
description: Finds the fastest and second-fastest entries in a list of running times.

name: File-backed Task List
description: A console reference exercise for managing tasks stored in a UTF-8 text file.

name: Search and Sort Practice
description: A reference exercise implementing insertion sort, merge sort, and first-match binary search.
